newsitem.title: IRAN: Pope John Paul congratulates new Iranian president.
newsitem.headline: Pope John Paul congratulates new Iranian president.

text.p: Pope John Paul has sent a telegram of congratulations to Iran's new President Mohammad Khatami, the official Iranian news agency IRNA reported on Sunday.

"In his message, Pope John Paul II wished the Iranian people harmony and happiness and said that he asks almighty God to assist the Iranian nation in its journey towards material and spiritual progress," IRNA said.

Khatami, a Shi'ite Moslem clergyman known for his moderate political views, was confirmed in office on Sunday by spiritual leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei and is due to be sworn in in parliament on Monday.
